content_sections.heading: NCDC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 09/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NCDC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Sugar Engineering/Sugar Technology Experience: Total 5 years of experience in the relevant field Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on last date of receipt of application) Other conditions: The appointment is purely on a contract basis without any right to regular appointment. Consolidated remuneration includes applicable taxes with no other allowances. Desirable: 5 years experience in related field

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Negotiable based on previous/current pay. Initially engaged for a period of 3 years, extendable by 1 year up to a maximum of 4 years for specific projects. Continuation is subject to satisfactory annual performance review based on Key Performance Indicators. Can be terminated at any time by giving one month notice or one month's remuneration in lieu thereof.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCDC Recruitment 2026 by Email

Send the application via email to [email protected] . Mention 'Application for Young Professional-II (Sugar)' in the subject line of the email. Email it on or before 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NCDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Young Professional-II (Sugar).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NCDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 19 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on last date of receipt of application).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Negotiable based on previous/current salary.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Sugar Engineering/Sugar Technology.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The appointment is purely on a contract basis without any right to regular appointment. Consolidated remuneration includes applicable taxes with no other allowances.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on educational records and experience. Interview/Personal discussion of shortlisted candidates. Shortlisting of candidates based on educational qualifications and experience. Interview or personal discussion for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially engaged for a period of 3 years, extendable by 1 year up to a maximum of 4 years for specific projects. Continuation is subject to satisfactory annual performance review based on Key Performance Indicators. Can be terminated at any time by giving one month notice or one month's remuneration in lieu thereof.
